process.commandLine: bash -c 'set -u; echo SANDBOX_NETNS=$(readlink /proc/self/ns/net); if ! timeout 8 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/9.9.9.9/443" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo INCLUDED_DEST_UNREACHABLE; exit 1; fi; echo INCLUDED_DEST_OK; timeout 8 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/1.1.1.1/443" >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ $? = 0 ]; then echo EXCLUDED_DEST_LEAKED; exit 1; fi; echo EXCLUDED_DEST_BLOCKED_OK; timeout 6 bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/10.0.2.2/{{LISTENER_PORT}}" >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ $? = 0 ]; then echo HOST_LOOPBACK_LEAKED; exit 1; fi; echo HOST_LOOPBACK_BLOCKED_OK'
